subject.title: fix(ui): validate session-catalog agent against the live roster

question: Should this protected Control UI routing change proceed after a current-main refresh and after-fix live proof, or should maintainers choose a narrower compatibility policy for pre-roster selections and catalog deep links?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the patch intentionally changes the upgrade-visible behavior of persisted/provisional agent selections before the roster is available.

options.title: Refresh and prove before merge

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused suites and existing production diagnosis while accepting the remaining live compatibility uncertainty.
